title: Group Fitness Class Passes: how many packs a member may hold open at once
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis governing how many class-credit packs a single member may hold open concurrently, across every tier of the product.

## Basis no longer in force
The sentence "A member may hold up to 2 class-credit packs open at the same time (any status other than closed)" is no longer in force as the general handling basis for this ceiling; a different basis governs how that same numeric ceiling is checked and enforced at the point a pack refund is being recorded.

## Basis still in force
A general class-credit pack, alongside at most one further open pack of any status other than closed (for example, a general pack alongside one Specialty Studio Pack), remains within the ceiling; a third concurrently open pack is not permitted. Separately, and independently of the count above, a member may not hold two Unlimited Monthly Classes packs open at the same time — this exclusion applies regardless of how many total open packs the member otherwise holds.

## Points of judgement
- "Open" means any lifecycle status other than closed: applied, active, exhausted and expired packs all count toward the ceiling; only a closed pack does not.
- The two-pack figure itself remains the valid numeric ceiling for this product; what changed is only which handling basis re-checks and enforces it at the moment a refund is recorded against a pack.
